kebab_example: aliyun gpdb list-schemas --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secret-arn acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ --database adbtest --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSchemas

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the access credential for the created Data API account. You can call the CreateSecret operation to create an access credential.

To call the ListSchemas operation as a Resource Access Management (RAM) user, the RAM user must have the permissions to call the UseSecret or GetSecretValue operation on the ARN of the access credential
parameters.help_zh:
访问凭证。通过CreateSecret接口创建。

通过子账号访问此接口时，需要有对此SecretArn的UseSecret或GetSecretValue的权限
parameters.name: secret_arn

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页时返回的最多数目，范围在1～100之间
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，下一个查询开始Token
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The schema name pattern for matching. For example, `ab%` specifies to match schema names that start with ab
parameters.help_zh: Schema名称匹配值，如```ab%```表示以ab开头的名称
parameters.name: schema_pattern

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
NextToken.description_zh: 分页查询时，下一个查询开始Token

Status.description_en:
The status of the operation. Valid values:

success
fail
Status.description_zh:
API执行状态，取值如下：
success：执行成功。
fail：执行失败
